description: This Swift source file defines the RootCanvas view for an iOS application using SwiftUI. It manages the main UI components, onboarding flow, gateway status, environment dependencies, and user interactions within the app.

classes.name: RootCanvas
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view managing the app's core UI, onboarding, and gateway status presentation.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Data structure representing the payload for the home canvas UI updates.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Data structure representing individual agent information for display in the home canvas.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: Sub-view responsible for core UI layout, including the toolbar and optional voice wake overlay.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: View for displaying a flash overlay effect, used during camera flash events.

methods.name: startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines which startup presentation route (none, onboarding, settings) to use based on app state.

methods.name: shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides if the quick setup sheet should be presented based on app and gateway state.

methods.name: updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables the device's idle timer based on whether the app should prevent sleep.

methods.name: updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status overlay in the app's UI.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Encodes current app state into a JSON and updates the home canvas display.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Generates the payload data for the home canvas based on current app and gateway status.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Resolves the ID of the currently active agent, falling back to default if needed.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Gets the default agent ID based on current gateway configuration.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Generates a list of agent cards for display, sorted by activity status.

methods.name: homeCanvasName
methods.description: Returns a normalized name for an agent, falling back to ID.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Generates an emoji or initials badge for an agent.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string and returns nil if empty.

methods.name: evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Decides whether to present onboarding or navigate directly based on app state.

methods.name: hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is an existing gateway configuration.

methods.name: maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Automatically opens the settings sheet if applicable during startup.

methods.name: maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides whether to present the quick setup sheet based on current state.
